# 3-Day Budget Lisbon Plan for 2 Adults

A compact Lisbon trip built around historic areas, viewpoints, one museum, food markets, and moderate walking. I’ve kept the stay in a central, transit-friendly area and paced each day to avoid long uphill stretches.

## Lisbon Itinerary, Budget, and Stay Strategy

### Trip setup
- Dates: **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-12**
- Travelers: **2 adults**
- Total budget: **€900 excluding flights**
- Best base area: **Baixa/Chiado** or **Avenida da Liberdade / Marquês de Pombal**
- Why this works: central, safe-feeling, easy Metro access, and good for short rides between sights

### 3-Day Plan
Day 1: Baixa, Alfama edges, and a viewpoint evening
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, and settle near **Baixa/Chiado**; keep the first walk flat and short.
- Afternoon: Explore **Praça do Comércio**, **Rua Augusta**, and the lower streets of **Baixa**; use the tram/Metro if needed.
- Evening: Take a gentle viewpoint stop at **Miradouro de Santa Luzia** or **Portas do Sol**; finish with a relaxed dinner in Alfama edge streets.
- Food: Try a simple tascas meal, grilled fish, or bifana sandwiches.
- Action: [Button: View area map](https://www.google.com/maps/search/Baixa+Chiado+Lisbon)

Day 2: Museum, historic neighborhood, and live music night
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/music-note.svg
- Morning: Visit **Museu Nacional do Azulejo** or **Carmo Archaeological Museum**; choose one to keep the pace easy.
- Afternoon: Head to **Chiado** and **Bairro Alto** for browsing, coffee, and short scenic stops.
- Evening: Reserve this night for **live music** in a fado or jazz venue; keep dinner simple beforehand.
- Food: Eat at a local market or casual restaurant, then have a small dessert stop.
- Action: [Button: Find live music](https://www.google.com/maps/search/live+music+Lisbon)

Day 3: Market morning, scenic views, and relaxed departure day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
